bibl.title: From Hades to the Stars: Empedocles on the Cosmic Habitats of Soul.
bibl.seg: Simon Trépanier, From Hades to the Stars: Empedocles on the Cosmic Habitats of Soul.
bibl.note: Introduction: the unity of Empedocles' thought. - 1. The long-lived daimones and the transmigrating soul. - 2. Life in Hades and levels of life. - 3. Section d, lines 5-10 of the Strasbourg papyrus [P. Stras. Inv. 1665-1666 (= MP3 356.11; LDAB 824)]: the law of exile: a. The location of section d and the structure of On Nature I; - b. Text and edition; - c. The law at line d 7; - d. The position of section d and the attribution of B 115; - e. Line d 8: the very deep place and life in Hades. - 4. Cosmology: the three-level scheme and the long-lived gods. - Conclusion.
